title: TVK government's focus on filing cases raises questions about addressing public concerns
summary: The Tamil Nadu government, led by TVK, has been accused of prioritizing the filing of cases over addressing public issues. DMK leader V Senthil Balaji alleged that the government is focusing only on filing cases and not on people's problems. The opposition party claims that the government is neglecting its responsibilities towards its citizens. The Tamil Nadu government has denied these allegations, stating that it is committed to resolving the issues faced by its people. However, critics argue that the government's focus on filing cases is a distraction from addressing the real concerns of its citizens.
summary_points: The Tamil Nadu government, led by TVK, has been accused of prioritizing the filing of cases over addressing public issues.
